info.title: NIPOPETO Pet Healthcare API
info.description: Current REST/JSON backend contract. Known policy and concurrency limitations are documented in the architecture audit.

503.description: Database unavailable; API reports degraded health

post.summary: Staff creates a counter customer profile without login credentials
post.description: Admin/staff only. Name and Vietnamese phone are required; email/address are optional. Normalizes +84 phones and detects existing contacts. Creates role owner with login disabled, returns no token or password. Does not change the staff session.

409.description: Existing phone/email, including a concurrent creation

post.description: Owners create for their authenticated account. Staff supply ownerId for an existing user with role owner; missing owners or staff accounts are rejected with 422.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Giữ nguyên key khi gửi lại cùng yêu cầu; cùng key và payload khác trả 409.

post.description: Tạo một yêu cầu lưu trú chưa thanh toán. Chống gửi lặp và trùng ngày cho cùng thú cưng.

patch.description: Staff records receipt of funds. Unpaid becomes paid atomically. Repeating the same method preserves paidAt; a different method or refunded invoice returns 409. This endpoint does not charge an external payment provider.

post.summary: Owner obtains invoice for own completed fixed-price spa or checked-out hotel
post.description: Chủ nuôi tự tạo yêu cầu thanh toán cho spa có giá cố định sau khi hoàn tất. Khách sạn cần nhân viên chốt phí, không hỗ trợ endpoint này.

post.summary: Staff issues a single-use activation link for a verified counter customer
post.description: Does not reset an active account or change the profile email yet. Staff must hand the link to the verified customer. Records issuer, issue/expiry/use/revocation timestamps; stores a token digest. Response Cache-Control: no-store.

201.description: Issued for 30 minutes; reissue revokes all pending links

post.summary: Inspect a valid activation token without exposing customer records
post.description: Public token-based operation, subject to the shared auth rate limit (50 requests per IP per 15 minutes). Cache-Control: no-store. Customer logs in separately after activation; original owner ID and records remain unchanged.

422.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or consumed token; invalid password

post.summary: Set password on the existing owner profile; consume the token once
post.description: Public token-based operation, subject to the shared auth rate limit (50 requests per IP per 15 minutes). Cache-Control: no-store. Customer logs in separately after activation; original owner ID and records remain unchanged.

422.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or consumed token; invalid password

409.description: Email became unavailable; no credentials or token consumption committed

TooManyRequests.description: Auth rate limit exceeded (50 requests per 15 minutes)

transferContent.description: Stable transfer purpose; legacy invoices retain their original instruction.

PublicPetProfile.description: QR-safe pet projection. Medical fields appear only when publicProfile.showMedicalAlerts is true; internal notes are never public.

phone.description: Vietnamese phone with 10 local digits, or +84/84 and 9 digits. Spaces/dots/hyphens/parentheses are normalized.

email.description: Optional; blank means no email. Saved lowercase.

ownerId.description: Required for staff creation: id of an existing owner account. Ignored for owner requests; the authenticated owner id is used.

expectedRevision.description: statusRevision from the booking displayed to the user; stale values return 409.

MedicalRecordUpdateInput.description: Staff may edit medical details only. petId, ownerId and appointmentId are fixed after creation; attempts to change or clear them return 422. Older clients may send unchanged values.

subtotal.description: Legacy appointment fee when items is omitted; omit for hotel bookings.

items.description: Appointment final charges; hotel extras only (stored booking base is added automatically).

token.description: Single-use secret; send in JSON body, never URL query. Only its SHA-256 digest is stored.
